text:
maria_g: quick heads up — i'm scheduling a short safety drill during tonight's change window. will exercise pin + fast rollback flow for tf modules. please read the playbook below and ack.
infra-oncall: ack. what time is the window?
maria_g: window 23:00–23:30 UTC, drill planned for 23:10. will do a dry-run apply then an emergency rollback.
sam_t: ok, tagging owners. i'll stop canaries if anything spikes.
jonathan_k: FYI i updated the release notes to include the module pin details and the rollback steps. link: https://internal/release-notes/infra-pin-2026
anya_r: please confirm which modules get pinned and to which commit/versions.
maria_g: modules: `networking_v2` -> tag v2.4.1, `iam_roles` -> commit 3a7d9f2, `tf-provider` pinned to 4.12.0. adding entries to the PR now.
deploybot: deploybot: queued job #4821: `tfplan infra/staging` (initiated by maria_g). Preview available at https://ci/deploy/4821
sam_t: grabbing plan now.
jonathan_k: plan looks like expected. no resource replacements for prod-facing LB, just security group changes.
infra-oncall: add a temporary circuit-breaker in the routing policy? just in case.
maria_g: good call — adding `routing.allowlist: canary-only` flag in vars for the drill.
anya_r: what are the exact rollback commands we should run if we need to abort?
maria_g: two-step rollback: 1) run `terraform apply -target=module.iam_roles -var='version=3a7d9f2'` to pin IAM back, 2) run `terraform apply -var='routing.allowlist=all'` to revert routing gate. if deploybot job fails, manual rollback playbook in Confluence.
deploybot: deploybot: plan finished (job #4821) — no diffs flagged as destructive.
sam_t: starting dry-run apply at 23:10 UTC. i will monitor token-level latency and error rates.
infra-oncall: i'll have on-call pager open, will route alerts to #incidents if anything hits thresholds.
jonathan_k: quick reminder — metrics to watch: auth lat p95, kv-cache miss rate, egress bandwidth from edge routers.
maria_g: executing dry-run now. pasting snippet: ```bash
deploybot trigger job 4821 --mode=dry-run
# returns: plan saved at /tmp/plan-4821.plan
```
deploybot: deploybot: executed dry-run for job #4821; plan stored.
anya_r: seeing a flakiness alert from staging tests — small spike in grpc 5xx around 23:12, could be unrelated.
sam_t: i'm pausing the apply. noting timestamps and reverting the routing flag locally.
maria_g: thanks — this is why we do drills. rolling back dry changes now, following the rollback steps.
deploybot: deploybot: triggered rollback job #4822 for modules [iam_roles, networking_v2] (initiated by sam_t).
infra-oncall: all good — alert noise cleared.
jonathan_k: post-drill notes: need clearer preflight for grpc endpoints, add a `smoke-test` stage right after plan.
maria_g: agreed. i'll update the release checklist and the PR with a smoke test step and rerun the drill next week. @everyone thumbs up if you're good with the actions. :thumbsup:
sam_t: :thumbsup:
anya_r: :thumbsup:
jonathan_k: :thumbsup:
infra-oncall: :thumbsup:
maria_g: thanks all. i'll create a short follow-up doc with exact timestamps and the artifacts (plan IDs, job numbers).
